optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Compliance Operations Specialist, After-Sales Service Network
professionalSummary: Experienced compliance specialist with a proven track record of developing recall-handling procedures, defining compliance checks, and ensuring consistent application across partner networks. Demonstrated ability to coordinate with legal and partner management, conduct monthly compliance reviews, and document limitations and hand‑over conditions for procedure releases.
experienceHighlights: Authored recall‑handling procedure and compliance check definitions for the partner portal; tested with three volunteer partners in sandbox over two quarters, recording outcomes per check.
Conducted monthly compliance reviews with legal and partner management, presenting sandbox test results, addressing open questions, and logging outcomes.
Coordinated rule changes with legal and partner management via procedure change log; scheduled and executed release of checks to live partner network with portal product team after legal sign‑off.
Prepared release notes detailing known limitations (sandbox tenant lacking partner service systems) and hand‑over items for portal team.
Managed end‑to‑end compliance operations for partner portal over ~18 months, including procedure definition, sandbox testing, monthly reviews, and change coordination.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Compliance check definitions and sandbox test outcome sheet for three volunteer partners, including sandbox tenant record identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s involvement in developing and testing compliance procedures, conducting reviews, coordinating rule changes, and documenting limitations. They do not confirm direct deployment of the procedures to the live partner network or execution of the release by the candidate.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate demonstrates strong compliance operations experience but lacks direct evidence of deploying procedures to the live partner network.
